en.tagline: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt
en.summary: This skill runs AI image models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA styles, editing, upscaling and text rendering. You pick a model by app ID and pass a prompt as JSON input.
problem: Image generation services differ in models, inputs and output options. Each one needs its own setup and its own request format.
With this skill, one CLI and one JSON input format cover many models. You choose a model by its app ID, such as `openai/gpt-image-2-6-flare` or `falai/flux-dev-lora`, and run it with `belt app run`.
fit: Generating concept art, illustrations or product mockups from text prompts
Editing an existing image with a prompt, such as changing the background
Creating social media or marketing graphics that include readable text
unfit: Video generation, which has its own separate skill
Users who cannot run the belt CLI or sign in with `belt login`
steps: Pick a model from the table by its app ID, for example `falai/flux-dev-lora` for custom styles or `openai/gpt-image-2-6-flare` as the default.
Write a prompt and pass it in JSON, for example `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora --input '{"prompt": "..."}'`.
For edits, add an image URL in the `images` field, as in the GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst example.
Use `belt app list --category image` to find other image apps, including upscalers such as `falai/topaz-image-upscaler`.

zh.tagline: 用50多种AI模型生成和编辑图片
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行工具调用 AI 图片模型。支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、图片编辑、放大和文字渲染。你按应用 ID 选择模型，并用 JSON 格式传入提示词。
problem: 不同的图片生成服务，模型、输入方式和输出选项各不相同，每个都要单独配置，请求格式也不同。
使用这个技能后，一个命令行工具和一种 JSON 输入格式就能调用多个模型。你只需要选定应用 ID，例如 `openai/gpt-image-2-6-flare` 或 `falai/flux-dev-lora`，再用 `belt app run` 运行即可。
fit: 根据文字提示生成概念图、插画或产品效果图
用提示词修改已有图片，例如更换背景
制作带有清晰文字的社交媒体或营销图
unfit: 视频生成，这由另一个独立技能负责
无法运行 belt 命令行或无法用 `belt login` 登录的用户
steps: 先用 `belt login` 登录一次。
从表格中按应用 ID 选择模型，例如风格定制可选 `falai/flux-dev-lora`，默认可选 `openai/gpt-image-2-6-flare`。
用 JSON 传入提示词，例如 `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora --input '{"prompt": "..."}'`。
做图片编辑时，在 `images` 字段中填入图片 URL，参考 GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst 的示例。
用 `belt app list --category image` 查找其他图片应用，包括 `falai/topaz-image-upscaler` 等放大工具。
